name: Design
title: Design (canvas)
description: Designs as local files: a canvas of live HTML artboards (screens, components, prototypes) with notes and pages, arranged, edited in place and tweaked in a local page. Can install a design system and use its tokens and components.
summary: A canvas of live HTML artboards: screens, pages, components and prototypes.
when: The person wants UI screens, a web or landing page design, app mockups, component explorations, diagrams, print pieces or a clickable prototype as an editable canvas they can view, rearrange and tweak.
